description: Na₄Mg(WO₄)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imm2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with five WO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.52 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.57 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent WO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one WO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.96 Å) and two longer (1.97 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted WO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.85 Å) and two longer (1.96 Å) W-O bond lengths. In the second W site, W is bonded to four O atoms to form WO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are two shorter (1.87 Å) and two longer (1.93 Å) W-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one W atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃W tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one W atom.
